en: greaT, thankS.
ja: よかった、ありがと。

key: TERRA: Much better.
en: TERRA: Much better.
ja: テラ: だいぶマシになった。

key: But if you were expecting me to be back to my usual chaotic persona, I'm going to have to disappoint you.
en: But if you were expecting me to be back to my usual chaotic persona, I'm going to have to disappoint you.
ja: いつもの気まぐれなキャラに戻ってると思ってたなら、悪いけど期待外れよ。

key: That umbral energy draws out the most destructive parts of a person...
en: That umbral energy draws out the most destructive parts of a person...
ja: あの闇のエネルギーは、人の中で一番破壊的な部分を引き出すの……

key: ...Because somebody thought that was a convenient plot device...
en: ...Because somebody thought that was a convenient plot device...
ja: ……誰かが、それを都合のいい展開装置だとでも思ったんでしょうね……

key: ...But in my case, it doesn't really matter.
en: ...But in my case, it doesn't really matter.
ja: ……でも、あたしの場合、そんなの大した問題じゃない。

key: I was already there.
en: I was already there.
ja: もうとっくに、そこにいたんだから。

key: I still have some of that juice in me, so bear with it for a moment.
en: I still have some of that juice in me, so bear with it for a moment.
ja: まだあのジュースが少し残ってるから、ちょっとの間我慢して。

key: My parents generally expected me to get good grades, stay out of trouble, blah-blah-blah.
en: My parents generally expected me to get good grades, stay out of trouble, blah-blah-blah.
ja: うちの親は、大体成績を良くしろとか、面倒事を起こすなとか、まあそういうことをずっと期待してた。

key: They weren't especially strict compared to other parents, and it's not like they were abusive.
en: They weren't especially strict compared to other parents, and it's not like they were abusive.
ja: 他の親と比べて特別厳しかったわけじゃないし、虐待されてたってわけでもない。

key: But I always got really shaken up whenever I did get in trouble, with them or anyone else.
en: But I always got really shaken up whenever I did get in trouble, with them or anyone else.
ja: でも、彼らとでも他の誰とでも、トラブルになるたびに、あたしはいつもひどく動揺してた。

key: It was crushing.
en: It was crushing.
ja: 押しつぶされるみたいだった。

key: It was ridiculous, but every time it felt like I was about to be char-broiled and executed.
en: It was ridiculous, but every time it felt like I was about to be char-broiled and executed.
ja: バカげてるけど、毎回まるで焼き殺されて処刑されるみたいな気分になってた。

key: Talk about an overreaction.
en: Talk about an overreaction.
ja: 大げさにもほどがあるってやつ。

key: So, to avoid that feeling, I got used to living my life the way others thought I should:
en: So, to avoid that feeling, I got used to living my life the way others thought I should:
ja: だからその感覚を避けるために、みんなが「こうあるべき」って思う通りの生き方に慣れていった。

key: Wake up, go to school, do the work, come home, study, go to sleep,
en: Wake up, go to school, do the work, come home, study, go to sleep,
ja: 起きて、学校に行って、課題をやって、帰って、勉強して、寝て、

key: Rinse, lather, repeat.
en: Rinse, lather, repeat.
ja: それを、ただただ繰り返すだけ。

key: Just like all other 7 billion whatever people on this planet.
en: Just like all other 7 billion whatever people on this planet.
ja: この星にいる何十億人だかの、他のみんなと同じように。

key: Automatic process; automatic life.
en: Automatic process; automatic life.
ja: 自動化された過程、自動化された人生。

key: Stay in line, wait for the mid-life crisis to kick in.
en: Stay in line, wait for the mid-life crisis to kick in.
ja: 列を乱さず、中年の危機がやってくるのをただ待つ。

key: All of it is just so pointless.
en: All of it is just so pointless.
ja: 全部、本当に無意味だった。

key: Then I met her.
en: Then I met her.
ja: それから、あいつに出会った。

key: I met the real her-- not that doll.
en: I met the real her-- not that doll.
ja: 本物のあいつに――あの人形じゃなくて。

key: She really... opened my eyes.
en: She really... opened my eyes.
ja: あいつは本当に……あたしの目を開かせてくれた。

key: "If it's pointless anyway, you may as well have fun with it," she said.
en: "If it's pointless anyway, you may as well have fun with it," she said.
ja: 「どうせ無意味なら、楽しんじゃった方がいい」って、あいつは言った。

key: Break the rules, color outside of the lines-- why not?
en: Break the rules, color outside of the lines-- why not?
ja: ルールを破って、枠からはみ出せばいい――そうしない理由がある?

key: Isn't it better than living a cookie-cutter life?
en: Isn't it better than living a cookie-cutter life?
ja: 型にはまった人生を生きるより、よっぽどマシでしょ。

key: She went on to do just that.
en: She went on to do just that.
ja: あいつは実際、その通りに生きてた。

key: She found me, and recruited me to the team to help rescue her.
en: She found me, and recruited me to the team to help rescue her.
ja: あいつはあたしを見つけて、自分を救い出す手伝いをさせるためにチームに引き入れた。

key: I found freedom under her power.
en: I found freedom under her power.
ja: あいつの力の下で、あたしは自由を見つけた。

key: Because with her, the rules didn't matter anyway.
en: Because with her, the rules didn't matter anyway.
ja: あいつと一緒なら、ルールなんてどうせ関係なかったから。

key: She was in it for the same reason--
en: She was in it for the same reason--
ja: あいつも同じ理由でやってた――

key: Everything is awful; may as well have some fun.
en: Everything is awful; may as well have some fun.
ja: 何もかも最悪なんだから、楽しんじゃった方がいい。

key: I think I was the only person she trusted, because we had that in common.
en: I think I was the only person she trusted, because we had that in common.
ja: あいつが信頼してたのは、たぶんあたしだけだったと思う。それが共通点だったから。

key: There's probably a lot I could tell you about her and her plans.
en: There's probably a lot I could tell you about her and her plans.
ja: あいつとその計画については、話せることが色々あると思う。

key: But I don't think she'd want that.
en: But I don't think she'd want that.
ja: でも、あいつはそれを望んでないと思う。

key: Even now, she's probably watching.
en: Even now, she's probably watching.
ja: 今もたぶん、あいつは見てる。

key: Aren't you?
en: Aren't you?
ja: でしょ?

key: Did you bring me back out of pity?
en: Did you bring me back out of pity?
ja: あわれみであたしを連れ戻したの?

key: Or was it boredom?
en: Or was it boredom?
ja: それとも、退屈しのぎ?

key: TERRA: ...It looks like I'm left out to guess at it now too.
en: TERRA: ...It looks like I'm left out to guess at it now too.
ja: テラ: ……どうやら、それも今じゃあたしが推測するしかないみたいね。

key: I don't care enough to.
en: I don't care enough to.
ja: そこまで気にしてないけど。

key: I didn't ask to come back.
en: I didn't ask to come back.
ja: 戻ってきたいなんて、頼んでない。

key: Better to go out with a bang than burn out and fade away.
en: Better to go out with a bang than burn out and fade away.
ja: 燃え尽きて消えていくより、派手に散った方がいい。

key: And I don't think I have that much zaniness left in me anyway.
en: And I don't think I have that much zaniness left in me anyway.
ja: それに、あたしにはもうそんなにおかしなノリも残ってないと思うし。

key: What about you?
en: What about you?
ja: あんたはどうなの?

key: Did you find it funny-- all of my antics before?
en: Did you find it funny-- all of my antics before?
ja: 前のあたしのバカ騒ぎ、面白かった?

key: TERRA: Well, that's nice I guess.
en: TERRA: Well, that's nice I guess.
ja: テラ: まあ、それならいいけど。

key: TERRA: Just obnoxious, right?
en: TERRA: Just obnoxious, right?
ja: テラ: ただうざかっただけ、でしょ?

key: Sometimes I even annoyed myself with it all.
en: Sometimes I even annoyed myself with it all.
ja: 自分でもうんざりすることあったし。

key: But it's better than withering away under monotony.
en: But it's better than withering away under monotony.
ja: でも、単調さの中でしぼんでいくよりはマシだった。

key: That's what I told myself.
en: That's what I told myself.
ja: そう自分に言い聞かせてた。

key: I shouldn't still be here.
en: I shouldn't still be here.
ja: もうここにいるべきじゃないのに。

key: TERRA: Just let me go.
en: TERRA: Just let me go.
ja: テラ: もう、放っておいて。

key: Both of you.
en: Both of you.
ja: あんたたち二人とも。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
